data.one_liner: An assortment of widgets that loom over your content.
data.what_it_does: Provides single-purpose overlay widgets such as Cupertino-style popover toolbars and menus. Integrates with the follow_the_leader package for easy positioning and layout.
use_when: You need iOS-style popover menus or toolbars in your Flutter application
You want widgets that float or loom over your main content using follow_the_leader positioning
avoid_when: You are looking for non-widget utilities or state management solutions
You do not need popover or floating overlay components
strengths: Includes specific implementations like CupertinoPopoverToolbar and CupertinoPopoverMenu
Integrates seamlessly with the follow_the_leader package for alignment and boundaries
weaknesses: Limited documentation and examples outside of the changelog descriptions
Narrow scope focusing specifically on overlay/popover widgets
